checks.lean:
example : T3.MyEquivalence (fun a b : Nat => a = b) where
  reflexive := by
    intro x
    rfl
  symmetric := by
    intro x y h
    exact h.symm
  transitive := by
    intro x y z hxy hyz
    exact hxy.trans hyz
checks.message: Equality must be a model with all three independent fields.

checks.lean: example {α β : Type*} (f : α → β) (x : α) : T3.EquivClass (T3.SameFiber f) x = f ⁻¹' {f x} := by ext y; simp [T3.EquivClass, T3.SameFiber, eq_comm]
checks.message: A fibre must be precisely the equivalence class of the kernel relation.

hints.hint: Use `∀ x, R x x`. Do not quantify the two arguments independently.
Use `∀ x y, R x y → R y x`.
Use `∀ x y z, R x y → R y z → R x z`.
Use the set builder `{y | R x y}`.
Define `f x = f y`; then `{y | SameFiber f x y}` is `f ⁻¹' {f x}`.
